reusedEvidence.coverage: Existing 72/72 phase, full-state oracle, omitted-state poisoning and convergence evidence reused because all payload/layout/OPLL executable bytes are unchanged. Fresh tests cover public descriptor handling, map, guard and non-FM paths.

auditConclusion.formatRejection: No live restoration writes; local snapshot/scratch staging can change.
auditConclusion.lateDDRTimeout: Existing baseline limitation: eight VRAM bytes restored in fault-injection probe before timeout, CPU/FM not applied; no rollback.
auditConclusion.recommendation: Retain existing FM prevalidation; document late transport failure limitation. No architectural change.
